entities.name: Manuel Martí i Saragossà
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Manuel Martí was a Spanish humanist scholar. Born near Valencia in 1663, he published a collection of poems, entitled Amalthea Geographica, and made several translations from the Latin. He died in Alicante in 1737.
